android.desc:
Estroclic is a birth control pill reminder and pack tracker built for people who want clarity without fertility tracking. See which pill day you are on, remember your daily dose, and know when to start your next pack.

Unlike period and fertility apps, Estroclic focuses on your contraceptive pill routine. No ovulation predictions. No pregnancy planning. Just your pill schedule.

PILL REMINDERS AND PACK TRACKING

• Set a daily pill reminder at the time you choose
• Receive backup reminders and alerts for your next pack
• See your current pill day with a clear visual pack tracker
• Track active pills, placebo pills, and break days automatically
• Continue tracking clearly when you skip placebo pills
• Support for combined pills, progestin-only mini-pills, and extended-cycle pills

ESTROCLIC PREMIUM

Upgrade for deeper tracking and planning tools:

• Record missed pills and health events such as vomiting, diarrhea, or medication use
• View a timing window based on your selected pill schedule
• Keep reminders aligned with timezone changes while traveling
• Get refill and pack-ending reminders
• Review your complete pill calendar and pack history
• See adherence patterns and cycle insights
• Export a PDF pack report to discuss with your doctor or pharmacist
• Look up supported pill brands and ingredient information

PRIVATE, FOCUSED, AND EASY TO USE

Estroclic is designed specifically for contraceptive pill tracking. Your health data is not sold or shared with advertisers. Data is encrypted in transit, and you can request account and data deletion.

IMPORTANT HEALTH INFORMATION

Estroclic is a personal tracking and reminder tool. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. 
Estroclic does not provide medical advice or determine whether you are protected from pregnancy. Always consult a qualified doctor or pharmacist for advice about missed pills, medication interactions, side effects, diagnosis, or treatment.
